find:
leverage: summary !== null && typeof summary === 'object'
      ? -nonNegativeCount(summary.blocking)
      : undefined,
why: Dependency leverage becomes a constant, so an issue that unblocks five open issues no longer outranks one that unblocks none, and a payload without a summary is no longer reported as undetermined. Both tests fail: the leverage order and the criterion-skip report.
killedBy: candidate ranking prefers the candidate whose completion unblocks more open work
candidate ranking skips a criterion for the whole ranking when it cannot be determined for every candidate
